name: Lyrics Romanizer
author: Illumye
description: Writes lyrics in Japanese, Korean and Cyrillic scripts in Latin letters, offline, under each line of the songs whose lyrics come without a romanization.

actions.name: lyrics.provide
actions.why: Gives the song's lyrics back with each line also in Latin letters

actions.name: spotify.catalog
actions.why: Reads Spotify's lyrics of the song, to romanize the very lines shown

actions.name: network
actions.why: Reads the song's lyrics on lrclib.net when Spotify has none
